claim_text: Flight Centre says unknown persons may have accessed a significant number of customer records in a third-party booking system
summary: Flight Centre Travel Group says that "a significant number of customer records in the impacted system may have been accessed by unknown persons", in a third-party accommodation booking system used by some of its leisure brands.
detail: It says it is not yet clear how many of those records were actually taken out of the system. It calls what it found "unusual activity".
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company's own statement to the Australian Securities Exchange says it in these words; ABC News and The Register report the same.

claim_text: Flight Centre has not named the booking system or its supplier
summary: Flight Centre calls it "a third-party accommodation booking system" and refers to "the third-party vendor" without naming either.
detail: None of the outlets we read names the supplier. The Register mentions an earlier, separate breach at another Australian booking-software company, RMS Cloud, but does not link it to Flight Centre.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The statement names neither; The Register does not name the supplier either.

claim_text: Flight Centre has not said when the activity started or was found
summary: ABC News reports: "It is not clear exactly when the breach was discovered." Flight Centre's statement gives no dates for the activity.
detail: Flight Centre declined to comment further to ABC News.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The statement gives no dates; ABC News says so in its own reporting.

claim_text: Most records hold only names; a very small share includes passport details and other personal data
summary: Flight Centre says most accessed records "comprise only customer names, some with basic travel information". A "very small percentage" may include limited passport details, emails, phone numbers, birth dates or health data.
detail: This is from the company's initial review; it has given no numbers.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The statement says it in these words; ABC News quotes the same.

claim_text: Flight Centre says no access to card or bank details has been found
summary: Flight Centre says: "To date, no access to customer credit card, payment or bank account details has been identified."
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The statement says it in these words; ABC News reports the same.

claim_text: The affected system serves Flight Centre, Travel Associates, Cruiseabout and some independent agents; flight and corporate bookings are not affected
summary: Flight Centre says the activity was found only in the accommodation system used by the Flight Centre brand, Travel Associates, Cruiseabout and some independent agents. "Flight bookings are not impacted"; corporate travel uses other systems.
detail: Its leisure brands keep operating and customers can travel on their existing accommodation bookings.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The statement says it; ABC News reports the same brands and exclusions.

claim_text: Flight Centre says it contained the activity, changed keys and credentials, and is working with the supplier and Mandiant
summary: Flight Centre says it worked with the third party to contain the activity, "change authentication keys and credentials and increase monitoring on the system", and is working with the vendor and its incident response partner Mandiant.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The statement says it; The Register reports the same.

claim_text: Flight Centre is notifying authorities and will contact affected customers
summary: Flight Centre says it "is in the process of notifying the relevant authorities" and "will be taking steps to contact relevant impacted customers". It asks customers to be alert to unexpected emails, calls or messages about their bookings.
detail: It does not name the authorities. It says further updates will be posted on its website.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The statement says it in these words; ABC News reports the same advice.

claim_text: No group has claimed responsibility in the reporting so far
summary: None of the reports we read names anyone who claims to have carried out the attack, and Flight Centre speaks only of "unknown persons".
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Neither the statement nor the two outlets name or report a claim of responsibility.
